generic.Defined scope/population: Open fast-track claims with a triage tier assigned and no litigation, fatality, or coverage-dispute flag
generic.In-scope period: Fast-track claims assigned during the current reporting month
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Template code, severity band, indemnity amount and expense amount present on the reserve transaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posted reserve total equals the template value or the approved override amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reserve transaction retains template version, posting timestamp and handler ID in ClaimCenter
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every template override carries a reason code and an override note with the approval outcome
generic.Test population: All fast-track template reserve transactions posted in the period in Guidewire ClaimCenter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires non-zero indemnity and expense lines on 100 percent of fast-track template reserves
generic.Exception handling path: Disqualified claims leave fast-track and are re-reserved by the Claims Examiner under full guidelines
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Template amount matches the severity band table for line of business, cause of loss and damage tier
generic.Evidence location: Financials > Reserves screen and reserve transaction history on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Confirm fast-track eligibility on the claim summary in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim summary and read the triage tier assigned at FNOL.
Check the litigation, fatality and coverage-dispute indicators on the claim header.
Route the claim out of fast-track where any disqualifying indicator is set.
Done when eligibility is confirmed and recorded on the claim.
verify: Re-read the claim header indicators after the eligibility decision.
Pass when the claim carries a fast-track tier and no disqualifying flag.

steps.title: Select the severity band template on the Financials > Reserves screen
sop: Read line of business, cause of loss and damage tier from the exposure record.
Open Financials > Reserves and pick the template matching all three attributes.
Reject any template whose effective date does not cover the loss date.
Done when the matching template is selected on the reserve screen.
verify: Compare the selected template code against the published severity band table.
Pass when the template code matches line of business, cause of loss and damage tier.

steps.title: Confirm the template posts split indemnity and expense lines in ClaimCenter
sop: Preview the reserve transaction before saving and read the generated lines.
Confirm one indemnity line and one expense line are produced per exposure.
Escalate to the Claims Examiner where a single combined amount appears.
Done when both component lines are visible on the pending transaction.
verify: Inspect the pending transaction line list for cost category values.
Pass when a non-zero indemnity line and a non-zero expense line are both present.

steps.title: Record any override amount with a reason code on the reserve transaction
sop: Leave the template amount unchanged unless the file facts contradict the band.
Select a documented override reason code from the picklist before editing the amount.
Write an override note stating the facts that justify the deviation.
Done when every overridden amount carries a reason code and a note.
verify: List overridden reserve lines on the claim and open each note.
Pass when no overridden amount exists without a reason code and note.

steps.title: Reconcile the posted total to the template value before saving in ClaimCenter
sop: Sum the indemnity and expense lines on the pending transaction.
Compare the sum against the template value or the approved override figure.
Correct the entry rather than saving and adjusting afterwards.
Done when the pending total equals the expected value.
verify: Recompute the line sum after the correction.
Pass when posted total equals template value or approved override with no variance.

steps.title: Save the reserve transaction and confirm the audit stamp in ClaimCenter
sop: Save the transaction and confirm it moves to posted status.
Check the transaction history shows template code, handler ID and timestamp.
Raise an incident where the transaction stalls in an error queue.
Done when the reserve is posted with a complete audit stamp.
verify: Reopen the reserve transaction history on the claim.
Pass when the posted transaction shows the fast-track template code, handler ID and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims requiring a reserve where a published reserving guideline exists for the line of business
generic.In-scope period: Reserves set or revised during the current reporting month
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line of business, claim type, guideline name, version and section cited on the reserve note
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of reserved claims equals count of claims with a guideline citation recorded
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Guideline edition number and note timestamp retained against the reserve transaction
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claim types outside any published guideline are logged and escalated to the reserving actuary
generic.Test population: All reserve notes created in the period in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a guideline name, version and section on every in-scope reserve note
generic.Exception handling path: Unguided claim types go to the reserving actuary for a documented bespoke basis
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserve reflects ultimate probable exposure as prescribed, not the most-likely-settlement figure
generic.Evidence location: Reserve note on the claim plus the guideline edition held in the claim file repository

steps.title: Read line of business and claim type from the claim summary screen
sop: Open the claim summary and record the line of business and claim type.
Confirm the coverage in question matches the claim type being reserved.
Note multi-coverage claims so each coverage is guided separately.
Done when line of business and claim type are confirmed for each coverage.
verify: Compare the recorded values against the policy declarations on the claim.
Pass when line of business and claim type match the policy record.

steps.title: Open the current reserving guideline edition in the claim file repository
sop: Retrieve the guideline from the controlled repository, not a local or emailed copy.
Check the edition effective date covers the current valuation date.
Discard any superseded edition found in personal folders.
Done when the current controlled edition is open.
verify: Compare the opened edition number to the repository current-version marker.
Pass when the edition in use is the published current edition.

steps.title: Apply the guideline valuation basis to the reserve figure
sop: Read the prescribed valuation basis for the claim type from the guideline.
Value the exposure at ultimate probable exposure, not at expected settlement.
Recalculate where an earlier figure used a settlement-value basis.
Done when the reserve figure is computed on the prescribed basis.
verify: Compare the computed figure against the guideline worked example for the claim type.
Pass when the basis used matches the guideline prescription.

steps.title: Cite the guideline section and paragraph in the reserve note
sop: Write the reserve note against the reserve transaction in the claims platform.
State the guideline name, version and the section and paragraph relied on.
State how that section drove the reserve basis chosen.
Done when the citation is saved on the reserve transaction.
verify: Reopen the reserve note and read the citation text.
Pass when name, version and section are all present in the note.

steps.title: Escalate unguided claim types to the reserving actuary
sop: Identify claim types with no matching guideline section.
Raise an escalation on the claim with the facts and the proposed basis.
Do not post a guideline citation that does not cover the exposure.
Done when the escalation is logged and a basis is agreed.
verify: List claims with no guideline citation and check each for an escalation record.
Pass when every unguided claim carries a dated escalation record.

steps.title: File the applied guideline extract on the claim in the document repository
sop: Save the applied guideline section extract to the claim file repository.
Name the document with the guideline version and the claim number.
Link the document ID from the reserve note.
Done when the extract is filed and linked.
verify: Open the reserve note link and confirm it resolves to the filed extract.
Pass when the linked document matches the cited guideline version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All reserve lines posted on open claims awaiting release to the ledger
generic.In-scope period: Reserve lines created or amended in the current accounting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure, coverage code, loss cause, cost category, accident year and segment on every line
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of reserve lines equals count of lines with complete segment coding
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coding verification note and timestamp retained on the exposure record in ClaimCenter
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines found in suspense or unallocated segments are logged with the correction applied
generic.Test population: Reserve lines extracted from Guidewire ClaimCenter into the Excel coding review workbook
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero lines coded to suspense, default or unallocated segments
generic.Exception handling path: Miscoded lines are corrected by the Claims Examiner before the reserve is released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accident year matches loss date and reporting segment matches the policy declarations page
generic.Evidence location: Exposure record coding tab in ClaimCenter and the Excel coding review workbook

steps.title: Extract the period reserve lines from ClaimCenter into Microsoft Excel
sop: Run the reserve line extract for the open claims in scope.
Include exposure, coverage code, loss cause, cost category, accident year and segment.
Load the extract into the Excel coding review workbook.
Done when the extract is loaded with the full column set.
verify: Compare extract row count to the ClaimCenter reserve line count for the period.
Pass when row counts agree and no required column is blank in the header.

steps.title: Check coverage code and loss cause against the exposure record
sop: For each line, compare the coded coverage against the exposure it sits under.
Compare the coded loss cause against the cause recorded at FNOL.
List mismatches for correction rather than editing the extract only.
Done when every line has a confirmed coverage and loss cause.
verify: Recheck the mismatch list after corrections are applied in ClaimCenter.
Pass when no line shows a coverage or loss cause differing from the exposure record.

steps.title: Confirm the indemnity and expense split on each reserve line
sop: Filter the workbook for lines with a default or blank cost category.
Recode each to indemnity or expense according to the nature of the exposure.
Reject any posting to a general holding bucket.
Done when every line carries an explicit cost category.
verify: Pivot the workbook by cost category and review the value totals.
Pass when no reserve value sits in a default or blank cost category.

steps.title: Match accident year and policy period to the loss date on the claim
sop: Compare each line accident year to the loss date, not the report date.
Compare the policy period on the line to the policy in force at loss date.
Flag lines where a late-reported claim was coded to the report year.
Done when accident year and policy period agree with the loss date.
verify: Rerun the accident year comparison column in the workbook.
Pass when no line shows an accident year differing from the loss date year.

steps.title: Reconcile the reporting segment to the policy declarations page
sop: Read state, line and program from the declarations page on the policy record.
Compare each reserve line segment against those values.
Correct segment coding in ClaimCenter where it diverges.
Done when every segment matches the declarations page.
verify: Sample the corrected lines against the declarations page again.
Pass when segment values match the declarations page on every sampled line.

steps.title: Clear suspense and unallocated lines before releasing the reserve
sop: Filter for suspense, unallocated and other segment values.
Recode each line to its proper segment in ClaimCenter.
Log each correction with the original and corrected values.
Done when the suspense filter returns no rows and the verification note is saved.
verify: Refresh the extract and refilter for suspense and unallocated segments.
Pass when zero reserve lines remain in suspense, default or unallocated segments.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every reserve transaction posted on an open claim that requires a rationale note
generic.In-scope period: Reserve postings made within the current guideline documentation window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure components, source evidence dates, confidence level and key uncertainty stated in the note
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Component amounts stated in the note sum to the posted reserve total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Note timestamp on the reserve transaction shows entry inside the guideline window
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late or backfilled notes are logged with the reason and the supervisor decision
generic.Test population: Reserve transactions posted in the period in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a rationale note on 100 percent of reserve transactions in scope
generic.Exception handling path: Missing notes are raised on the handler diary and completed before the next file review
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Note names medical specials, wage loss, general damages, expense and any recovery offset
generic.Evidence location: Reserve transaction note in the claims platform and source documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Open the reserve transaction note field rather than a claim-level note
sop: Locate the reserve transaction just posted in the claims management platform.
Open the note field attached to that transaction.
Do not use the general claim notes tab for the rationale.
Done when the note is being written against the transaction itself.
verify: Check where the draft note appears in the transaction history view.
Pass when the note is attached to the reserve transaction, not the claim notes list.

steps.title: State the exposure components that build the reserve figure
sop: List medical specials, wage loss, general damages and expense as separate amounts.
State any expected recovery offset separately from gross exposure.
Confirm the listed components sum to the posted reserve.
Done when all components and the offset are stated.
verify: Add the component amounts in the note and compare to the posted reserve.
Pass when the component sum equals the posted reserve total.

steps.title: Name the source evidence and dates from the claim file repository
sop: Identify the police report, repair estimate, medical records and coverage opinion relied on.
Record each document name and its date from the claim file repository.
Do not cite evidence that is not filed on the claim.
Done when each relied-on document is named with its date.
verify: Open each cited document from the repository link.
Pass when every cited document exists on the claim with the stated date.

steps.title: State the confidence level and the key uncertainty in the note
sop: Record the confidence level in the current valuation using the guideline wording.
Name the single uncertainty most likely to move the reserve materially.
State what evidence would resolve that uncertainty.
Done when confidence and key uncertainty are recorded.
verify: Read the note back for a stated confidence and a named uncertainty.
Pass when both are present and the uncertainty is specific to this claim.

steps.title: Save the note inside the guideline documentation window
sop: Save the note in the same session as the reserve posting where possible.
Compare the note timestamp against the reserve posting timestamp.
Flag any note entered after the window for supervisor review.
Done when the note is saved and its timestamp is inside the window.
verify: Compare note and transaction timestamps in the transaction history.
Pass when the note timestamp falls within the guideline window of the posting.

steps.title: Link the supporting documents to the reserve note in the repository
sop: Attach or link each cited document ID to the claim record.
Confirm the links open the correct version of each document.
Replace links that resolve to superseded versions.
Done when every cited document is linked from the note.
verify: Click through each link from the saved note.
Pass when all cited documents open from the note with no broken link.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open exposures on claims requiring separate indemnity, ALAE and litigation reserve components
generic.In-scope period: Exposures reserved or re-reserved during the current reporting month
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cost type, exposure ID, claimant ID and amount populated on each reserve component
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of component reserves equals the claim total incurred reserve in ClaimCenter
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each component transaction retains its own timestamp and handler ID
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blended or pooled reserves found are logged and split with the correction recorded
generic.Test population: Reserve components on all open exposures in Guidewire ClaimCenter for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires distinct indemnity and expense lines on every open exposure
generic.Exception handling path: ALAE found inside an indemnity cost type is reversed and reposted to the ALAE cost type
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Multi-claimant losses carry one reserve per claimant rather than a single pooled amount
generic.Evidence location: Financials > Reserves component list on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: List every open exposure and claimant on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the exposures tab and list each exposure with its claimant and coverage.
Confirm every known claimant has an exposure record created.
Create missing exposures before reserving.
Done when the exposure list is complete for all claimants.
verify: Compare the exposure list against the claimants named in the FNOL and file notes.
Pass when every named claimant has an open exposure record.

steps.title: Create a discrete indemnity reserve on each exposure
sop: Post an indemnity reserve against each exposure separately.
Do not post one blended claim-level indemnity figure.
Value each exposure on its own facts and damages.
Done when every open exposure carries its own indemnity reserve.
verify: Filter the reserve list by indemnity cost type and group by exposure.
Pass when each open exposure shows exactly one indemnity reserve line.

steps.title: Create a separate ALAE reserve for defense, expert and IA costs
sop: Post an ALAE reserve covering defense counsel, experts and independent adjuster fees.
Base the amount on the expected engagement scope, not a flat percentage.
Keep the ALAE reserve on its own cost type.
Done when an ALAE reserve exists for each exposure incurring expense.
verify: Filter the reserve list for the ALAE cost type.
Pass when an ALAE reserve exists and holds no indemnity amounts.

steps.title: Add a litigation reserve component where suit is filed or anticipated
sop: Check the litigation indicator and any pre-suit demand on the claim.
Post a litigation reserve component where suit is filed or reasonably anticipated.
Base the amount on the litigation plan or the venue benchmark.
Done when litigated exposures carry a litigation reserve component.
verify: Cross-check litigated exposures against the litigation reserve component list.
Pass when every litigated or suit-anticipated exposure has the component posted.

steps.title: Confirm each component posts to its own cost type in the ledger feed
sop: Open the ledger feed preview for the posted reserve components.
Confirm ALAE maps to the expense reserve account and indemnity to the loss account.
Raise a mapping defect where a component lands in the wrong account.
Done when all components map to their intended accounts.
verify: Compare the feed preview account codes to the account mapping table.
Pass when no ALAE amount maps to an indemnity reserve account.

steps.title: Reconcile component totals to claim incurred in ClaimCenter
sop: Sum indemnity, ALAE and litigation components across all exposures.
Compare the sum to the claim total incurred reserve on the financials summary.
Investigate any difference before closing the task.
Done when the component sum equals claim incurred reserve.
verify: Re-run the summation after any correction.
Pass when component totals equal the claim incurred reserve with zero variance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims whose total incurred indemnity plus expense breaches the large-loss threshold for the line
generic.In-scope period: Threshold breaches occurring on the current business day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, accident year, coverage, cause of loss, reserve split and expected ultimate in the notice
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of threshold breaches in the warehouse equals count of notifications issued
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification record and actuarial acknowledgement retained with dates on the claim file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Breaches notified late are logged with the reason and the corrective action
generic.Test population: All claims above the large-loss threshold in the enterprise data warehouse extract
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires same-day notification for 100 percent of first-time threshold breaches
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged notifications are chased on diary and escalated to the reserving actuary
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim appears on the large-loss watchlist feed the reserving actuary reviews
generic.Evidence location: Large-loss notification record on the claim and the watchlist feed in the data warehouse

steps.title: Compare total incurred against the published large-loss threshold
sop: Read total incurred indemnity plus expense from the claim financials summary.
Look up the large-loss threshold for the line of business.
Treat the first breach date as the trigger date.
Done when the breach and its trigger date are established.
verify: Recompute total incurred from the reserve and paid components.
Pass when the computed incurred figure matches the financials summary and the threshold test.

steps.title: Assemble the notification content from the claim record
sop: Collect claim number, accident year, coverage and cause of loss.
Collect the current indemnity and expense reserve split.
State the expected ultimate and the basis for it.
Done when all required content items are assembled.
verify: Check the assembled content against the required field list.
Pass when no required notification field is missing.

steps.title: Issue the large-loss notification on the trigger day
sop: Submit the notification through the claims platform large-loss workflow.
Send on the day the threshold is first breached, not at the next diary.
Do not batch notifications to a weekly cycle.
Done when the notification is submitted and dated.
verify: Compare the notification date to the trigger date.
Pass when the notification date equals the trigger date.

steps.title: Confirm the claim joins the large-loss watchlist feed in the warehouse
sop: Query the large-loss watchlist feed in the enterprise data warehouse.
Confirm the claim appears with its reserve split and accident year.
Raise a feed defect where the claim is absent after the next refresh.
Done when the claim is present on the watchlist feed.
verify: Re-query the feed after the scheduled refresh.
Pass when the claim is present with the same reserve figures as the claim record.

steps.title: Review the notification and record actuarial acknowledgement
sop: Review the notified reserve split and expected ultimate against reserving assumptions.
Record the acknowledgement back on the claim file with any queries raised.
Request further detail where the expected ultimate lacks a basis.
Done when the acknowledgement is logged on the claim.
verify: Open the claim notification record and read the acknowledgement entry.
Pass when a dated actuarial acknowledgement is present on the claim.

steps.title: Reconcile threshold breaches to notifications issued for the day
sop: Extract the day breach list from the enterprise data warehouse.
Match each breach to a notification record on the claim.
Chase unmatched breaches with the handling examiner the same day.
Done when every breach has a matching notification.
verify: Re-run the match after chasing.
Pass when the breach count equals the notification count with no unmatched claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: Proposed reserves that exceed the requesting handler authority band in the authority matrix
generic.In-scope period: Reserve approval requests raised in the current reporting month
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Prior reserve, proposed reserve, band breached, requester ID and approver ID on the workflow record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of over-authority reserves equals count of recorded approvals in the workflow
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval workflow record retains approver ID, decision and timestamp in ClaimCenter
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected or returned requests are logged with the reason and the resubmission outcome
generic.Test population: All reserve transactions above an authority band posted in the period in ClaimCenter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires an approval from a user whose band covers the amount on every such reserve
generic.Exception handling path: Requests without rationale are returned to the Claims Examiner rather than approved conditionally
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requester and approver are different users and the reserve stays pending until approval is applied
generic.Evidence location: Approval workflow history on the reserve transaction in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Check the proposed reserve against the authority matrix in ClaimCenter
sop: Look up the handler authority level held in the authority matrix.
Compare the proposed reserve amount against that band.
Do not infer authority from job title.
Done when the breached band is identified.
verify: Re-read the matrix entry for the requesting user.
Pass when the identified band matches the user record in the authority matrix.

steps.title: Route the request to the correct approver level in the workflow
sop: Route to the approver one level above the breached band.
Route to the next band up where two bands are crossed.
Use the system workflow rather than an email request.
Done when the request sits with the correct approver in the workflow.
verify: Open the pending approval task and read the assigned approver band.
Pass when the assigned approver band covers the proposed amount.

steps.title: Confirm the reserve stays pending and does not reach the ledger
sop: Check the reserve transaction status is pending approval.
Confirm no ledger feed entry has been generated for the pending amount.
Raise an incident where a pending reserve has fed the ledger.
Done when the transaction is confirmed pending with no feed entry.
verify: Query the ledger feed for the transaction reference.
Pass when no feed entry exists for a reserve still in pending status.

steps.title: Review the supporting rationale before deciding the request
sop: Read the reserve rationale note and the attached supporting evidence.
Return requests with no rationale rather than approving them.
Record the review basis in the approval comment.
Done when the decision is recorded with a comment.
verify: Open the approval record and read the comment.
Pass when the decision carries a comment referencing the supporting evidence.

steps.title: Confirm segregation between requester and approver
sop: Compare the requester user ID and the approver user ID on the workflow record.
Reject any request where they are the same user.
Escalate repeated self-approval attempts to claims leadership.
Done when the two user IDs are confirmed different.
verify: Query the period approvals for matching requester and approver IDs.
Pass when no over-authority reserve shows the same user as requester and approver.

steps.title: Apply the approval and release the reserve in ClaimCenter
sop: Apply the recorded approval to the pending reserve transaction.
Confirm the transaction moves to posted status.
Confirm the ledger feed entry is generated after posting.
Done when the reserve is posted with the approval attached.
verify: Open the transaction history and read status and approval linkage.
Pass when the posted reserve carries a linked approval from a covering authority band.

generic.Defined scope/population: Initial reserve transactions ready to post on newly assigned claims
generic.In-scope period: Current open accounting period only, with no posting to a closed period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, handler ID, authority level, cost type and accident year on the transaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims platform reserve total for the day equals the ledger feed reserve total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting timestamp and handler stamp retained on the reserve transaction
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interface suspense items are logged with cause and clearance before end of day
generic.Test population: All initial reserve postings and their ledger feed entries for the business day
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero reserve transactions unposted in the interface suspense queue
generic.Exception handling path: Failed feed entries are investigated by the Accountant and reposted the same day
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserve posts within the initial-reserve SLA measured from claim assignment
generic.Evidence location: Reserve transaction record in the claims platform and the loss reserve account in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Set the effective date to the exposure evaluation date
sop: Enter the effective date as the date the exposure was evaluated.
Confirm the date sits inside the open accounting period.
Never backdate into a closed period to correct timing.
Done when a valid in-period effective date is entered.
verify: Compare the effective date to the open period calendar.
Pass when the effective date sits within the current open accounting period.

steps.title: Confirm the handler ID and authority stamp on the transaction
sop: Check the handler ID recorded on the pending transaction.
Check the authority level stamped matches the handler matrix entry.
Correct the assignment where the transaction shows another user.
Done when handler ID and authority level are correct.
verify: Open the transaction detail and read the stamped fields.
Pass when handler ID and authority level are both populated and correct.

steps.title: Post the reserve within the initial-reserve SLA from assignment
sop: Read the assignment date from the claim record.
Post the reserve before the SLA elapses from that date.
Escalate where evidence gaps threaten the SLA.
Done when the reserve is posted inside the SLA window.
verify: Compute elapsed days between assignment and posting.
Pass when elapsed time is within the published initial-reserve SLA.

steps.title: Confirm the ledger feed entry reaches the correct loss reserve account
sop: Trace the transaction to its ledger feed entry in the ERP general ledger.
Confirm the account matches the line of business and accident year mapping.
Raise a mapping defect where the account is wrong.
Done when the feed entry is confirmed in the correct account.
verify: Compare the posted account code to the account mapping table.
Pass when the entry sits in the mapped loss reserve account for the line and accident year.

steps.title: Clear the interface error and suspense queue before end of day
sop: Open the interface suspense queue for claims financial transactions.
Investigate each item and identify the rejection cause.
Correct and repost items rather than deferring them overnight.
Done when the suspense queue holds no reserve transactions.
verify: Refresh the suspense queue after reposting.
Pass when zero claims reserve transactions remain in the suspense queue.

steps.title: Reconcile daily reserve totals between the claims platform and the ERP
sop: Extract the day reserve posting total from the claims platform.
Extract the corresponding ERP loss reserve movement for the day.
Investigate any difference and record the cause.
Done when both totals agree or the difference is explained.
verify: Re-run both extracts after any correction.
Pass when platform and ledger reserve totals agree for the day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Complex bodily-injury exposures requiring a projected rather than templated indemnity reserve
generic.In-scope period: Exposures valued or revalued in the current reserve review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Past specials, future medical, wage loss and general damages populated in the projection worksheet
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Worksheet component total equals the posted indemnity reserve on the exposure
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated projection worksheet and bill review summary attached to the claim file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exposures projected without current medicals are logged with the follow-up action
generic.Test population: All complex bodily-injury exposures with an indemnity reserve in Guidewire ClaimCenter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires an attached projection worksheet on every complex bodily-injury reserve
generic.Exception handling path: Missing medical records are chased on diary and the reserve is marked provisional until received
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Future medical is built from the treatment plan and life expectancy, not a billed-to-date multiplier
generic.Evidence location: Excel projection worksheet attached to the claim and the reserve note in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Obtain current medical records and the Coventry bill review summary
sop: Request current treatment records covering the compensable injury.
Pull the Medical Bill Review summary for billed and repriced amounts.
Do not project from records older than the last treatment milestone.
Done when current records and a bill review summary are on the claim.
verify: Check the latest treatment date in the records against the claim diary.
Pass when records and bill review cover treatment through the current valuation date.

steps.title: Build the future medical projection from the treatment plan in Excel
sop: List planned procedures, therapy and medication from the treating plan.
Apply duration from life expectancy or the stated treatment horizon.
Do not multiply billed-to-date by a flat factor.
Done when future medical is built line by line in the worksheet.
verify: Trace each projected line to a treatment plan entry.
Pass when every future medical line maps to a documented planned treatment.

steps.title: Separate past specials, future medical, wage loss and general damages
sop: Create a distinct worksheet line for each damages component.
Source past specials from the bill review repriced totals.
Source wage loss from employer records or the wage statement.
Done when all four components are present as separate lines.
verify: Check the worksheet for four populated component subtotals.
Pass when each component is separately stated and non-overlapping.

steps.title: Apply venue factor and comparative negligence to general damages
sop: Read the jurisdiction venue factor for the filing county.
Apply the comparative negligence assessment from the liability analysis.
State the assessed liability percentage in the worksheet.
Done when both adjustments are applied to general damages.
verify: Recompute general damages using the stated venue factor and liability percentage.
Pass when the worksheet figure equals the recomputed value.

steps.title: Post the projected indemnity reserve in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Post the indemnity reserve equal to the worksheet component total.
Confirm the amount does not exceed the applicable policy limit.
Adjust and re-document where the projection exceeds limits.
Done when the reserve equals the projected total within limits.
verify: Compare posted reserve to the worksheet total and the policy limit.
Pass when reserve equals the projection and sits at or below the policy limit.

steps.title: Attach the worksheet and cite it in the reserve note

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims with a posted initial reserve that require a first adequacy review diary

steps.title: Read the claim severity tier and guideline diary interval
sop: Read the severity tier from the triage record on the claim.
Look up the guideline adequacy review interval for that tier.
Do not default every claim to a single interval.
Done when the tier and its interval are established.
verify: Compare the chosen interval to the guideline interval table.
Pass when the interval matches the interval published for the severity tier.

steps.title: Shorten the interval for litigation, fatality or limits exposure
sop: Check litigation, fatality and policy-limits indicators on the claim.

Record the reason for the shortened interval on the diary.

steps.title: Create the diary activity with a review-specific subject

Name the subject so it reads as a reserve adequacy review.
Avoid generic subjects that mix with contact and status diaries.
Done when the diary exists with a distinguishable subject.

Pass when the adequacy diary is identifiable from the subject alone.

steps.title: Assign the diary to the handling adjuster by name
sop: Set the diary owner to the named handling adjuster.

Reassign automatically created diaries that default to a queue.
Done when the diary shows a named individual owner.

steps.title: Confirm the due date falls before the next financial close

Compare the diary due date against that date.
Bring the due date forward where it falls after close.
Done when the due date precedes the next close.

steps.title: Reconcile open claims to open adequacy diaries
sop: Extract open claims with a posted reserve from the claims platform.
Match each to an open reserve-adequacy diary.
Report unmatched claims to the handling examiner for diary creation.
Done when every open claim has a matching diary.

Pass when open claim count equals open adequacy diary count.

generic.Defined scope/population: Newly assigned claims with a triage severity tier and a verified coverage position

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Severity tier, damage assessment, policy limit, indemnity amount and expense amount populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of assigned claims equals count of claims with a non-zero indemnity reserve

generic.Exception handling path: Thin-fact claims take the guideline placeholder and a short diary rather than a zero reserve
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage verified and policy limits loaded before the reserve transaction date
generic.Evidence location: Reserve transaction and FNOL triage record on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Confirm coverage verification and policy limits on the claim record
sop: Open the coverage tab and confirm the coverage decision is recorded.
Confirm the policy limit is loaded against the coverage.
Hold the reserve where coverage is unverified and diary the follow-up.
Done when coverage is verified and limits are loaded.
verify: Compare the coverage verification date to the intended reserve date.
Pass when verification predates the reserve and a limit value is present.

steps.title: Read the triage severity tier and damage assessment from the FNOL record
sop: Open the FNOL record and read the assigned severity tier.
Read the damage assessment and injury description captured at intake.
Query the intake team where the tier and the facts disagree.
Done when tier and damage assessment are established.
verify: Compare the tier against the damage assessment narrative.
Pass when the tier is consistent with the recorded damage assessment.

steps.title: Map the tier to the guideline reserve band
sop: Look up the guideline reserve band for the tier and line of business.
Select the band value appropriate to the damage assessment.
Document the band chosen for the reserve note.
Done when the band value is selected.
verify: Re-check the band selection against the guideline band table.
Pass when the selected band matches the tier and line of business.

steps.title: Post indemnity and expense reserves as separate amounts in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the indemnity amount on its own reserve line.
Enter the expense amount on a separate reserve line.

Done when both amounts are posted as separate lines.
verify: Read the posted reserve line list for the claim.
Pass when a distinct indemnity line and expense line both exist.

steps.title: Post a guideline placeholder where facts are too thin to value
sop: Where facts do not support a valuation, post the guideline placeholder amount.
Never leave the indemnity reserve at zero past the SLA.
Set a short diary to revalue once evidence arrives.
Done when a placeholder and a short diary are in place.
verify: List claims with placeholder reserves and check for short diaries.
Pass when every placeholder reserve carries an open short-interval diary.

steps.title: Confirm posting inside the initial-reserve SLA from assignment date
sop: Extract assignment dates and reserve posting dates for the period.
Measure elapsed time from assignment, not from FNOL.
Report breaches to the handling examiner for immediate action.
Done when all in-period claims are measured and breaches reported.
verify: Re-run the SLA measure after breaches are cleared.
Pass when no open claim past the SLA carries a zero indemnity reserve.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims where new material evidence has been received since the last valuation

generic.Evidence location: Reserve change note in the claims platform and the document in the claim file repository

steps.title: Identify the triggering evidence and its receipt date in the claim file
sop: Review new documents received: IME report, demand package, surgery recommendation or wage records.
Record the document name and the date it was received on the claim.
Do not treat a diary date as the trigger.
Done when the trigger document and receipt date are identified.
verify: Compare the recorded receipt date with the repository intake stamp.

steps.title: Revalue the exposure against the new evidence
sop: Rebuild the exposure components using the new evidence.

State the revised component amounts before entering the transaction.
Done when the revised valuation is computed.
verify: Compare the revised components against the evidence content.

steps.title: Move indemnity and expense components separately in the platform
sop: Post the indemnity movement on the indemnity cost type.
Post the expense movement on the expense cost type.

Done when both movements are posted separately.
verify: Read the posted change transactions by cost type.
Pass when indemnity and expense movements appear as distinct transactions.

steps.title: Test the revised reserve against the policy limit
sop: Read the applicable policy limit from the coverage record.
Compare the revised total incurred against that limit.
Hold and escalate any change that would breach the limit.
Done when the revised reserve is confirmed within limit.
verify: Re-run the limit comparison after posting.
Pass when no posted reserve exceeds the policy limit on the coverage record.

steps.title: Post the change inside the guideline adjustment window
sop: Post the adjustment within the guideline window from evidence receipt.
Do not wait for the next scheduled diary.
Log the cause where the window is missed.
Done when the change is posted inside the window or logged as an exception.

Pass when elapsed time is inside the guideline adjustment window.

steps.title: Cite the triggering document ID in the reserve change note
sop: Attach the triggering document to the claim in the repository.
Cite its document ID and receipt date in the reserve change note.

Done when the note carries the document ID and date.

Pass when the note names the triggering document and it opens from the claim.

Route on the aggregate where the cumulative figure breaches the band.

sop: Open the attached evidence and the rationale note on the request.

sop: Record approve or reject in the claims platform approval workflow.

Pass when the decision, approver ID and timestamp are all recorded.

steps.title: Reconcile posted over-limit increases to approval records

sop: Name each evidence item and its date in the note.

sop: Enter the note against the reserve transaction record.

Done when the note is visible in the development history.

Pass when the rationale note is visible against the transaction.

steps.title: Reconcile material changes to rationale notes for the period
sop: Extract reserve changes above the materiality threshold for the period.

Return unmatched items to the handling examiner.

verify: Re-run the match after gaps are closed.
Pass when every material reserve change carries a component-level rationale note.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims with reserve movement recorded in the development report for the period

Count consecutive upward movements per claim.

sop: Apply the published rule for consecutive upward movements.

sop: Break the flagged list down by accident year and line of business.
Deliver to claims management and the reserving actuary.
Record the delivery date and recipients.
Done when the list is delivered and the delivery is recorded.

Pass when the flagged list was delivered on schedule with the required breakdown.

generic.Exception handling path: Exceptions are reported to claims management with an owner and a clearance date

steps.title: Extract period reserve movements with requester and approver fields

Load the extract into the Excel reconciliation workbook.

Pass when count and value both tie to the source report.

steps.title: Match above-band movements to recorded approvals

Match each to an approval record in the workflow history.
List unmatched movements as exceptions.
Done when the match is complete and exceptions are listed.
verify: Re-run the match after exception clearance.
Pass when no above-band movement remains unmatched.

steps.title: Test for same-day split movements on a single claim
sop: Group movements by claim and posting date.
Sum same-day movements and test the aggregate against the band.
Flag aggregates that breach a band without an approval.

sop: Compare requester and approver IDs on each movement.
Flag rows where the two are the same user.
Compare reserve totals per claim against the policy coverage limit.

sop: Compare the extract movement total to the ledger reserve movement for the period.

Record the reconciling items with their cause.
Done when the ledger comparison is complete and explained.

steps.title: Report the exception list to claims management
sop: Compile exceptions with claim number, amount and handler.
Assign an owner and a clearance date to each exception.
Deliver the list to claims management within the reporting deadline.
Done when the exception list is delivered with owners assigned.
verify: Check the delivered list against the workbook exception tab.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims with a reserve-adequacy diary due in the current review period

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred diaries are logged with a reason and a revised due date

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Next diary date reset at the interval matching the claim severity tier

steps.title: Open the reserve-adequacy diary queue for the period
sop: Filter the diary queue for adequacy reviews due in the period.

Plan the queue to be worked to zero within the period.
Done when the due list is established.

sop: Review current medical records and the liability assessment on each file.
Recompute the indemnity exposure on those facts.
Adjust the reserve where the valuation has moved.

Pass when each reviewed valuation is supported by current file evidence.

steps.title: Re-value expense against litigation posture and vendor commitments

Done when expense is re-valued on every reviewed file.
verify: Compare the expense reserve to the litigation plan budget.
Pass when the expense reserve covers the remaining planned spend.

sop: Write an explicit reserve-confirmed-adequate note where nothing changes.

verify: List reviewed claims with no reserve movement and read their notes.

steps.title: Reset the next diary date to the severity tier interval

Set the next diary at the matching guideline interval.
Shorten the interval where exposure has increased.

Pass when every reviewed claim has a next diary matching its tier interval.

verify: Check escalated files for a recorded escalation and decision.

sop: Extract claims crossing a reporting trigger in the period.
