sop: Check accident year and line of business are populated on every record.
Confirm the values match the source claim coding.
Escalate coding gaps to the handling examiner for correction.
Done when both dimensions are complete and correct.
verify: Group the extract by accident year and line of business.
Pass when no records fall into an unknown or blank dimension bucket.

steps.title: Separate reserve changes from paid transactions in the extract
sop: Confirm the transaction type field distinguishes reserve from paid.
Exclude paid transactions from reserve development factors.
Raise a defect where types are blended in one code.
Done when reserve and paid are separable in the extract.
verify: Pivot the extract by transaction type.
Pass when reserve and paid totals can be reported separately.

steps.title: Confirm reopenings and exposure additions appear as discrete events
sop: Identify reopened claims and exposures added after first reserve.
Confirm each appears as its own event in the history.
Correct source coding where these are netted into other movements.
Done when reopenings and additions are visible as events.
verify: Sample reopened claims and read their event history.
Pass when each sampled reopening appears as a discrete event.

steps.title: Reconcile extract totals to the claims ledger balance in Excel
sop: Sum the extract reserve balance at the cut-off date.
Compare against the claims ledger reserve balance at the same date.
Investigate and record any difference.
Done when totals agree or the difference is explained and corrected.
verify: Re-run the comparison after corrections.
Pass when no gap remains between extract total and ledger reserve balance.

steps.title: Release the reconciled history extract to actuarial
sop: Receive the extract with its reconciliation evidence attached.
Confirm the granularity supports triangle construction.
Reject and return extracts without a completed reconciliation.
Done when the extract is accepted for development analysis.
verify: Rebuild one accident year triangle from the extract.
Pass when the rebuilt triangle ties to the reconciled extract totals.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims with an in-force treaty or facultative certificate at the loss date
generic.In-scope period: Cessions computed for the current reporting period cut-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty number, attachment point, limit, cession basis, ceded paid and ceded outstanding
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded paid plus ceded outstanding equals the total ceded share computed
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated Excel cession calculation retained and linked to the claim record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Calculations exceeding a layer limit are logged and re-cut to the next layer
generic.Test population: All ceded calculations produced in the period for claims above attachment
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires no ceded amount above the layer limit on the applicable treaty
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous ALAE treatment is confirmed with the reinsurance function before booking
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calculation cites treaty or certificate number, attachment point, limit and cession basis
generic.Evidence location: Excel cession workbook attached to the claim in the claims management platform

steps.title: Identify the treaty or certificate in force at the loss date
sop: Read the loss date from the claim record.
Identify the treaty or facultative certificate in force on that date.
Do not use the treaty in force at the report date.
Done when the correct contract is identified.
verify: Compare the contract period against the loss date.
Pass when the loss date falls inside the identified contract period.

steps.title: Apply the correct cession basis from the contract terms
sop: Read the cession basis: quota share percentage, surplus lines ceded or excess layer.
Apply the attachment point and limit where the contract is excess of loss.
Record the basis applied in the workbook.
Done when the basis is applied and recorded.
verify: Recompute the cession using the contract terms.
Pass when the workbook cession matches the recomputed value.

steps.title: Confirm ALAE treatment under the contract before including it
sop: Read the ALAE clause to determine pro rata sharing or net treatment.
Include or exclude ALAE from the ceded calculation accordingly.
Confirm with the reinsurance function where the clause is ambiguous.
Done when the ALAE treatment is confirmed and applied.
verify: Compare the applied treatment against the contract clause text.
Pass when the ALAE treatment in the workbook matches the contract clause.

steps.title: Compute ceded share on paid and outstanding separately
sop: Compute the ceded share on paid amounts.
Compute the ceded share on outstanding reserves separately.
Keep the two figures distinct for recoverable and reserve booking.
Done when both ceded components are computed.
verify: Add ceded paid and ceded outstanding and compare to the total ceded share.
Pass when the two components sum to the total ceded share.

steps.title: Cap the ceded amount at the layer limit and push the balance up
sop: Compare the computed cession against the layer limit.
Cap the ceded amount at the limit where it is exceeded.
Allocate the balance to the next layer or to net retention.
Done when all amounts sit within their layer limits.
verify: Test each layer amount against its limit.
Pass when no ceded amount exceeds the limit on its layer.

steps.title: Attach the cession calculation to the claim for booking
sop: Attach the dated Excel cession workbook to the claim record.
Confirm ceded paid and outstanding figures used for booking match the workbook.
Return calculations lacking contract citations before booking.
Done when the calculation is attached and accepted for booking.
verify: Compare booked ceded figures against the attached workbook.
Pass when booked ceded paid and outstanding equal the workbook figures.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded claims with a treaty or facultative notification obligation not yet acknowledged
generic.In-scope period: Notification and acknowledgement deadlines falling in the current quarter
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, notice due date, acknowledgement due date and diary owner populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of ceded claims equals count of claims with both diaries open
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary records retained with creation timestamp and the treaty wording extract referenced
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diaries passing without acknowledgement are logged and escalated with the outcome
generic.Test population: Ceded claims in the enterprise data warehouse with a treaty deadline in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires open notification and acknowledgement diaries on every ceded claim before deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Lapsed notice risks are escalated to the reinsurance function the day the diary passes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice diary fires with lead time sufficient to assemble the loss advice
generic.Evidence location: Diary activities on the claim in the claims platform and the treaty deadline table

steps.title: Read the notification window from the specific treaty wording
sop: Open the treaty wording for the contract in force at loss date.
Read the notification window and the acknowledgement expectation.
Do not apply a single house default across all treaties.
Done when the contract-specific windows are established.
verify: Compare the recorded window against the treaty clause text.
Pass when the window recorded matches the treaty wording.

steps.title: Diary the notice due date with assembly lead time
sop: Compute the notice due date from the trigger date and the window.
Set the diary to fire early enough to assemble the loss advice.
Record the treaty reference on the diary subject.
Done when the notice diary is open with lead time.
verify: Compare diary fire date to the notice due date.
Pass when the diary fires before the due date with the stated lead time.

steps.title: Diary the acknowledgement due date separately
sop: Create a second diary for the acknowledgement due date.
Keep it distinct from the notice diary so both are tracked.
Assign both diaries to a named owner.
Done when the acknowledgement diary is open with an owner.
verify: Read both diaries on the claim.
Pass when notice and acknowledgement diaries exist as separate activities.

steps.title: Create certificate-specific diaries for facultative placements
sop: Identify any facultative certificate on the risk.
Create a diary per certificate with its own deadline.
Do not fold facultative deadlines into the treaty diary.
Done when each certificate has its own diary.
verify: List certificates on the claim and match to diaries.
Pass when each facultative certificate has a matching diary.

steps.title: Reconcile ceded claims to open diaries in the data warehouse
sop: Extract ceded claims with deadlines in the period from the warehouse.
Match each to open notification and acknowledgement diaries.
Report unmatched claims to the handling examiner.
Done when every ceded claim has matched diaries.
verify: Re-run the match after gaps are closed.
Pass when no ceded claim lacks an open notification or acknowledgement diary.

steps.title: Escalate diaries that pass without acknowledgement
sop: Review diaries that reach their due date unacknowledged.
Escalate immediately given the recovery can be voided by lapsed notice.
Record the escalation and the response on the claim.
Done when each lapsed diary is escalated and recorded.
verify: List passed diaries and check for escalation records.
Pass when every passed diary carries a dated escalation entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded claims where the reinsurer has disputed coverage, quantum or allocation
generic.In-scope period: Disputes raised or open during the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty clause cited, disputed paid, disputed outstanding and disputed ALAE amounts recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disputed components sum to the total disputed recoverable on the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reinsurer position recorded verbatim with date and the correspondence trail attached
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recoverables denied are flagged for collectability review rather than written off unilaterally
generic.Test population: All open reinsurer disputes recorded in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a dated escalation record naming the clause on every disputed position
generic.Exception handling path: Unanswered escalations are chased on diary and raised to claims leadership
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation includes the loss advice, treaty reference and full correspondence trail
generic.Evidence location: Escalation record on the claim and correspondence in the claim file repository

steps.title: Record the reinsurer position verbatim with the clause relied on
sop: Copy the reinsurer wording into the claim record without paraphrasing.
Record the treaty clause the reinsurer relies on.
Do not record a company interpretation at this step.
Done when the verbatim position and clause are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded text against the reinsurer correspondence.
Pass when the recorded position matches the correspondence wording.

steps.title: Quantify the disputed amount by paid, outstanding and ALAE
sop: Split the disputed recoverable into paid, outstanding and ALAE components.
Confirm the components sum to the total disputed amount.
Record each component against the claim.
Done when the disputed amount is fully componentised.
verify: Add the recorded components.
Pass when the component sum equals the total disputed recoverable.

steps.title: Assemble the escalation pack from the claim file repository
sop: Attach the loss advice, treaty reference and correspondence trail.
Include the quantified dispute breakdown.
Reject an escalation lacking any of these attachments.
Done when the escalation pack is complete.
verify: Check the pack contents against the required attachment list.
Pass when all required attachments are present in the pack.

steps.title: Route the escalation to the reinsurance function
sop: Submit the escalation through the claims platform escalation workflow.
Address it to the reinsurance function for treaty-level resolution.
Record the submission date on the claim.
Done when the escalation is logged with a date.
verify: Open the escalation record on the claim.
Pass when a dated escalation record exists naming the treaty clause.

steps.title: Keep the ceded recoverable booked and flag collectability
sop: Confirm the recoverable stays booked until formally denied.
Flag the balance for collectability review.
Do not authorise a unilateral write-off during the dispute.
Done when the recoverable is retained and flagged.
verify: Read the recoverable status and collectability flag on the claim.
Pass when the recoverable remains booked with a collectability flag set.

steps.title: Diary the escalation and record the resolution outcome
sop: Set a diary for the escalation response due date.
Chase where no response is received by the due date.
Record the resolution or commutation outcome on the claim.
Done when the outcome is recorded or the chase is logged.
verify: Read the escalation record for a resolution entry.
Pass when the escalation shows an outcome or a dated chase.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims tested against every treaty attachment point and facultative certificate on the risk
generic.In-scope period: Incurred positions as at the current period cut-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Total incurred including ALAE, treaty reference, attachment point and ceded flag on each claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of claims above attachment equals count of claims carrying the ceded flag
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated identification extract retained with the attachment table version used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims coded net-only in error are logged and recoded with the correction recorded
generic.Test population: Open claims in the enterprise data warehouse with incurred tested against attachment points
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a ceded notification flag on every claim with incurred above an attachment point
generic.Exception handling path: Claims trending toward attachment are watchlisted rather than ignored until breach
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Testing uses the treaty in force at loss date and any facultative certificate on the risk
generic.Evidence location: Identification extract in the data warehouse and the ceded flag on the claim record

steps.title: Extract open claim incurred including ALAE from the warehouse
sop: Extract total incurred with indemnity, expense and ALAE components.
Include loss date, line of business and current ceded coding.
Confirm ALAE is included since it changes which claims qualify.
Done when the extract is produced with ALAE included.
verify: Reconcile extract incurred totals to the claims platform.
Pass when extract incurred equals the platform incurred total.

steps.title: Test incurred against each treaty attachment point
sop: Join each claim to the treaty in force at its loss date.
Compare incurred against the attachment point for that treaty.
Record the test outcome per claim.
Done when every claim is tested against its treaty.
verify: Re-run the join using the attachment table.
Pass when every claim is matched to the treaty in force at its loss date.

steps.title: Test against facultative certificates on the risk
sop: Identify facultative certificates attaching to the policy.
Test incurred against each certificate attachment and limit.
Record certificate matches alongside treaty matches.
Done when facultative testing is complete.
verify: List claims with certificates and read their test results.
Pass when every certificate on the risk has a recorded test outcome.

steps.title: Include claims trending toward attachment on the watchlist
sop: Apply the trending threshold below attachment to catch approaching claims.
Add trending claims to the watchlist so notice is not late.
State the projected attachment date where available.
Done when trending claims are watchlisted.
verify: Read the watchlist for claims below but approaching attachment.
Pass when trending claims appear on the watchlist with a projection.

steps.title: Flag identified claims on the claim record in the platform
sop: Set the ceded notification flag on each identified claim.
Confirm the flag surfaces to the ceded workflow and the handler.
Do not rely on the extract alone to drive notification.
Done when every identified claim carries the flag.
verify: Query flagged claims and compare to the identification list.
Pass when flagged claim count equals identified claim count.

steps.title: Correct claims coded net-only in error
sop: Filter flagged claims currently coded net-retained only.
Recode each to the correct ceded treatment.
Log the original and corrected coding.
Done when no flagged claim remains net-only coded.
verify: Re-run the net-only filter on flagged claims.
Pass when no claim above attachment is coded net-retained only.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims flagged for ceded notification where a treaty reporting trigger has been met
generic.In-scope period: Triggers met within the current treaty notification window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, insured, loss date, cause, coverage, gross incurred, ceded share, reserve basis
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of triggered claims equals count of loss advices sent with confirmations filed
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss advice document and send confirmation filed on the claim with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late notices are logged as exceptions with the reason and remedial action
generic.Test population: All ceded claims with a notification obligation in the reporting period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero ceded claims with a notice date later than the treaty deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Missing content is completed and the advice reissued rather than sending a partial notice
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Facultative notices go to the certificate contact, not the treaty broker distribution list
generic.Evidence location: Loss advice and send confirmation filed on the claim in the claim file repository

steps.title: Confirm the trigger date and the treaty notice window
sop: Read the date the reporting trigger was met from the claim record.
Read the notice window from the treaty wording.
Compute the notice deadline from those two values.
Done when the deadline is computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the deadline from trigger date and window.
Pass when the recorded deadline matches the recomputed value.

steps.title: Assemble the loss advice content from the claim record
sop: Populate claim number, insured, loss date, cause and coverage.
Populate gross incurred, ceded share and the reserve basis.
Do not issue an advice with missing content fields.
Done when all required content is populated.
verify: Check the advice against the required content list.
Pass when no required field is blank on the advice.

steps.title: Address facultative notices to the certificate contact
sop: Read the certificate contact from the facultative placement record.
Send facultative notices to that contact directly.
Do not use the treaty broker distribution list for facultative notices.
Done when the correct recipient is set for each notice.
verify: Compare the recipient on each notice to the placement record.
Pass when facultative notices are addressed to the certificate contact.

steps.title: Issue the notice within the treaty window
sop: Send the loss advice before the computed deadline.
Do not defer issuance to a batching cycle.
Record the send date against the claim.
Done when the notice is issued and dated.
verify: Compare the send date to the deadline.
Pass when the notice date is on or before the treaty deadline.

steps.title: File the advice and send confirmation in the claim repository
sop: Save the issued advice document to the claim file repository.
Save the send confirmation alongside it.
Link both document IDs on the claim record.
Done when both documents are filed and linked.
verify: Open both documents from the claim record.
Pass when advice and send confirmation are both retrievable from the claim.

steps.title: Log the notice date against the deadline for exception reporting
sop: Record notice date and deadline on the ceded tracking record.
Mark any notice sent after the deadline as a late-notice exception.
State the reason and remedial action on each exception.
Done when all notices are logged with their deadline comparison.
verify: Run the late-notice exception report for the period.
Pass when every late notice carries a recorded reason and action.

generic.Defined scope/population: All notified ceded claims and every participating layer and reinsurer on each
generic.In-scope period: Correspondence and acknowledgements received in the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reinsurer name, reference number, date received and layer recorded on each acknowledgement
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of participating reinsurers equals count of correspondence records held per claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Correspondence filed under the claim with receipt date and version retained
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Acknowledgements not received in the diary window are chased with the chase recorded
generic.Test population: Notified ceded claims in the claim file repository for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires logged acknowledgements with reference and date on every notified claim
generic.Exception handling path: Correspondence found in personal mailboxes is refiled to the claim and the gap recorded
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: File retained per the records retention schedule so it is available at treaty audit
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance correspondence folder on the claim in the claim file repository

steps.title: File all reinsurer correspondence under the claim in the repository
sop: Save every inbound and outbound reinsurer item to the claim folder.
Do not leave correspondence in personal mailboxes or shared drives.
Refile items found outside the repository and note the gap.
Done when all correspondence sits under the claim.
verify: List correspondence items on the claim against known exchanges.
Pass when every known exchange is present in the claim folder.

steps.title: Log each acknowledgement with reinsurer, reference and date
sop: Create a log entry for each acknowledgement received.
Record reinsurer name, reference number and date received.
Link the acknowledgement document to the log entry.
Done when every acknowledgement is logged and linked.
verify: Compare log entries against filed acknowledgement documents.
Pass when each logged entry has a matching filed document.

steps.title: Cover every participating layer and reinsurer not only the lead
sop: List all participating reinsurers and layers on the placement.
Confirm correspondence exists for each participant.
Chase participants with no correspondence on file.
Done when every participant has correspondence recorded.
verify: Match the participant list to correspondence records.
Pass when no participating layer or reinsurer is missing correspondence.

steps.title: Chase acknowledgements outstanding past the diary window
sop: Review the acknowledgement diary for items past their window.
Issue a chase to the reinsurer or broker.
Record the chase date and method on the claim.
Done when every outstanding acknowledgement is chased and recorded.
verify: Read the chase entries against the outstanding list.
Pass when every outstanding acknowledgement carries a dated chase.

steps.title: Apply the records retention class to the correspondence file
sop: Set the retention class on the claim correspondence folder.
Confirm it matches the schedule required for treaty audit.
Correct folders defaulting to a shorter retention class.
Done when the correct retention class is applied.
verify: Read the retention class on the folder metadata.
Pass when the applied class matches the records retention schedule.

steps.title: Confirm the file is retrievable by claim and treaty reference
sop: Search the repository by claim number and treaty reference.
Confirm the correspondence file is returned by both searches.
Correct metadata where a search fails to return the file.
Done when both search paths return the file.
verify: Repeat both searches after any metadata correction.
Pass when the correspondence file is retrievable by claim number and treaty reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded-loss notification records and ceded recoverable balances at the quarterly cut-off
generic.In-scope period: The quarter being closed, using one cut-off date for both extracts
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, treaty reference, ceded paid and ceded outstanding on both extracts
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notified ceded totals equal the ledger ceded recoverable balance at cut-off
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed-off reconciliation file retained with cut-off date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notified-not-booked and booked-not-notified items are aged with an owner and clearance date
generic.Test population: Ceded notification records and ledger ceded balances for the quarter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero unexplained variance between notified ceded losses and the ledger
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched items are assigned an owner and cleared before the close is certified
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ceded paid and ceded outstanding are reconciled separately, not only in total
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly reconciliation file and the ceded recoverable account in the ERP general ledger

steps.title: Extract notification records and ledger balances at one cut-off
sop: Extract ceded notification records from the claims platform at the cut-off.
Extract the ceded recoverable balance from the ERP ledger at the same date.
Reject extracts taken at different cut-off dates.
Done when both extracts share the same cut-off.
verify: Compare the cut-off stamps on both extracts.
Pass when both extracts carry the same cut-off date.

steps.title: Match records on claim number and treaty reference
sop: Join the two extracts on claim number and treaty reference.
List notified-but-not-booked items separately.
List booked-but-not-notified items separately.
Done when both unmatched lists are produced.
verify: Re-run the join and count matched and unmatched rows.
Pass when matched plus unmatched counts equal the source record counts.

steps.title: Reconcile ceded paid and ceded outstanding separately
sop: Compare ceded paid totals between notification records and the ledger.
Compare ceded outstanding totals separately.
Do not net the two components into a single comparison.
Done when both components are compared.
verify: Read the two comparison results in the reconciliation file.
Pass when ceded paid and ceded outstanding each reconcile independently.

steps.title: Age unmatched items and assign owners and clearance dates
sop: Age each unmatched item from its origination date.
Assign a named owner and a clearance date to each.
Escalate items aged beyond the tolerance.
Done when every unmatched item has an owner and date.
verify: Read the exception tab for owner and date completeness.
Pass when no unmatched item lacks an owner and clearance date.

steps.title: Investigate and clear variances with the handling examiner
sop: Investigate each variance against the claim record.
Correct notification or booking errors at source.
Record the cause and correction against the item.
Done when each variance is explained or corrected.
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after corrections.
Pass when no unexplained variance remains between notified and booked ceded amounts.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off before the close is certified
sop: Present the reconciliation with aged items and explanations.
Obtain the reviewer sign-off with date.
Do not certify the close without the sign-off.
Done when the signed reconciliation is filed.
verify: Open the filed reconciliation and read the sign-off block.
Pass when a dated sign-off is present before close certification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinsurer queries received on covered losses, reserves and claim development
generic.In-scope period: Queries received within the current treaty response window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Query date, response date, figures quoted and privilege decision recorded on the claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures quoted to the reinsurer equal the ceded financials booked on the same date
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Query and response filed together on the claim with dates and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Queries answered outside the response window are logged with the reason
generic.Test population: All reinsurer queries logged in the claims platform for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a filed dated response within the treaty window for every query
generic.Exception handling path: Privileged defense material is withheld unless the access-to-records clause requires disclosure
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Response answers from the claim record covering reserve split, paid, liability and litigation posture
generic.Evidence location: Query and response documents filed on the claim in the claim file repository

steps.title: Acknowledge the query within the treaty response window
sop: Log the query with its receipt date on the claim.
Send an acknowledgement within the treaty-specified window.
Diary the full response due date.
Done when acknowledgement is sent and the diary is set.
verify: Compare the acknowledgement date to the receipt date and window.
Pass when acknowledgement falls within the treaty response window.

steps.title: Answer from the claim record on reserves and paid to date
sop: Read the current indemnity and expense reserve split from the claim.
Read paid to date from the claim financials.
Compose the answer from these records rather than recollection.
Done when the financial answer is drafted from the record.
verify: Compare the drafted figures against the claim financials screen.
Pass when the drafted figures match the claim record.

steps.title: Include liability assessment and litigation posture
sop: Summarise the liability assessment and comparative fault position.
Summarise the litigation posture including trial dates where set.
Keep the summary factual and sourced from the file.
Done when both elements are included in the draft.
verify: Compare the summary against the liability and litigation notes on file.
Pass when the summary is consistent with the file record.

steps.title: Apply the privilege decision before disclosure
sop: Identify privileged defense material within the requested scope.
Read the treaty access-to-records clause to test the disclosure obligation.
Redact or withhold where the clause does not require disclosure.
Done when the privilege decision is applied and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded privilege decision against the clause text.
Pass when the disclosure scope matches the access-to-records clause.

steps.title: Reconcile quoted figures to booked ceded financials
sop: Compare the figures in the draft response to the ceded financials booked.
Use the same as-at date for both.
Correct the response where the figures differ.
Done when quoted and booked figures agree.
verify: Re-run the comparison after any correction.
Pass when quoted figures equal the booked ceded financials at the same date.

steps.title: File the query and response together on the claim
sop: Save the query and the issued response to the claim file repository.
Link both documents so the exchange reads as one thread.
Record the response date against the query record.
Done when both documents are filed and dated.
verify: Open the query record and follow the response link.
Pass when each query has a filed dated response inside the treaty window.

generic.Defined scope/population: Litigated and expense-bearing claims requiring a forward ALAE accrual
generic.In-scope period: Accruals booked or re-based in the current accounting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Litigation plan budget, expert spend estimate, matter phase and ALAE cost type on the accrual
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accrual amount equals the sum of budgeted phase costs in the litigation plan
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Litigation plan version and accrual posting timestamp retained on the claim
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accruals set without a litigation plan are logged with the basis used and follow-up
generic.Test population: Litigated claims with an ALAE reserve in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a non-zero ALAE reserve traceable to a litigation plan on every litigated claim
generic.Exception handling path: Accruals posted to an indemnity account are reversed and reposted to ALAE
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accrual covers discovery, experts, mediation and trial for the full expected matter life
generic.Evidence location: ALAE reserve transaction on the claim and the expense reserve account in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Build the accrual from the litigation plan budget
sop: Read the litigation plan budget by phase from the claim file.
Add expected expert spend from the engagement scope.
Do not apply a flat percentage of indemnity.
Done when the accrual is built from plan components.
verify: Compare the accrual to the sum of budgeted phase costs.
Pass when the accrual equals the plan-derived total.

steps.title: Cover the full expected life of the matter
sop: Include discovery, experts, mediation and trial phases where suit is filed.
Extend the horizon to the expected trial or resolution date.
Do not accrue only to the next quarter.
Done when all expected phases are included.
verify: Check the accrual phase coverage against the litigation plan.
Pass when every planned phase is represented in the accrual.

steps.title: Post the accrual to the ALAE reserve cost type
sop: Select the ALAE reserve cost type on the transaction.
Confirm no part of the accrual lands in indemnity.
Reverse and repost where the wrong cost type was used.
Done when the accrual is posted on the ALAE cost type.
verify: Read the cost type on the posted transaction.
Pass when the accrual sits entirely on the ALAE reserve cost type.

steps.title: Confirm the accrual feeds the correct GL expense reserve account
sop: Trace the accrual to its ERP ledger entry.
Confirm the account matches the line and accident year mapping.
Raise a mapping defect where the account is wrong.
Done when the ledger entry is in the mapped expense reserve account.
verify: Compare the posted account code to the mapping table.
Pass when no ALAE accrual is posted to an indemnity reserve account.

steps.title: Re-base the accrual when the plan or trial date changes
sop: Monitor litigation plan revisions and trial date movements.
Re-base the accrual when either changes materially.
Record the revision reason on the transaction note.
Done when the accrual reflects the current plan.
verify: Compare the accrual date against the latest plan version date.
Pass when the accrual postdates the current litigation plan version.

steps.title: Reconcile litigated claims to non-zero ALAE reserves
sop: Extract litigated claims from the claims platform.
Match each to a non-zero ALAE reserve with a plan reference.
Report unmatched claims to the handling examiner.
Done when every litigated claim carries an ALAE accrual.
verify: Re-run the match after gaps are closed.
Pass when every litigated claim has a plan-traceable ALAE reserve.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed and open claims with ALAE spend segmented by claim type and line of business
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period plus the rolling twelve-month baseline
generic.Required fields populated and valid: ALAE spend by vendor category, incurred loss, claim type, line and accident year
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment ALAE totals sum to the period ALAE total in the data warehouse
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated Excel trend workbook retained with the extract version used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments beyond the variance threshold are logged with a documented explanation
generic.Test population: ALAE and incurred loss data extracted from the enterprise data warehouse for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires prior-period comparison and commentary on every segment beyond the threshold
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained movements are referred to the handling unit before the analysis is issued
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ratios normalised for claim volume and litigation rate before deterioration is concluded
generic.Evidence location: Excel trend workbook and the ALAE extract in the enterprise data warehouse

steps.title: Extract ALAE and incurred loss by segment from the warehouse
sop: Extract ALAE spend and incurred loss by claim type, line and accident year.
Include vendor category detail for legal, expert, IA and surveillance.
Reconcile the extract total to the ledger LAE balance.
Done when the extract is produced and reconciled.
verify: Compare extract totals to the ledger LAE balance.
Pass when extract and ledger totals agree.

steps.title: Compute the ALAE to incurred loss ratio by segment in Excel
sop: Compute the ratio for each claim type, line and accident year.
Exclude segments with insufficient volume from ratio conclusions.
Record the computation basis in the workbook.
Done when ratios are computed for every segment.
verify: Recompute a sample of ratios from the raw extract.
Pass when sampled ratios match the workbook values.

steps.title: Compare against prior period and the rolling twelve-month baseline
sop: Add prior-period and rolling twelve-month comparison columns.
Do not conclude from a single point comparison.
Highlight segments moving beyond the variance threshold.
Done when both comparisons are present for every segment.
verify: Check the workbook for both comparison columns.
Pass when prior period and rolling baseline are shown for each segment.

steps.title: Split legal, expert, IA and surveillance spend drivers
sop: Break each moving segment into its vendor spend categories.
Identify which category drives the movement.
Confirm category totals sum to the segment ALAE.
Done when drivers are identified for each moving segment.
verify: Sum the category detail per segment.
Pass when category totals equal the segment ALAE total.

steps.title: Normalise for claim volume and litigation rate
sop: Add claim counts and litigation rate per segment.
Restate the ratio on a normalised basis.
Withdraw deterioration conclusions that disappear after normalisation.
Done when normalised ratios are computed.
verify: Compare raw and normalised conclusions per segment.
Pass when each stated conclusion holds on the normalised basis.

steps.title: Document commentary for every segment beyond the threshold
sop: Write an explanation for each segment beyond the variance threshold.
Name the claims or vendors driving the movement.
Refer unexplained movements back to the handling unit.
Done when every threshold segment has commentary.
verify: List threshold segments and read their commentary.
Pass when no threshold segment is issued without an explanation.

generic.Defined scope/population: ALAE invoices that have passed line-item review and are awaiting payment approval
generic.In-scope period: Invoices submitted for approval in the current payment cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Invoice number, amount, vendor, claim number, reviewer ID and approver ID populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved invoice value equals the value released to the disbursement run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval record with approver ID and timestamp retained on the invoice transaction
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invoices returned for rework are logged with the reason and the resubmission outcome
generic.Test population: All ALAE payment approvals recorded in the period in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires two distinct approvers on every payment above the dual-approval threshold
generic.Exception handling path: Invoices with insufficient ALAE reserve are held until the reserve is increased
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approver is never the person who entered or coded the invoice
generic.Evidence location: Invoice approval history in the claims platform and the payment record in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Confirm line-item review was completed before approval
sop: Check the invoice carries a completed line-item review outcome.
Return invoices reaching approval without a prior review.
Do not treat the approval step as the first review.
Done when a completed review is confirmed on the invoice.
verify: Read the review record attached to the invoice.
Pass when a dated review outcome precedes the approval request.

steps.title: Compare the invoice amount against the approver authority band
sop: Look up the approver authority band in the authority matrix.
Compare the invoice amount to that band.
Route upward where the band is breached.
Done when the invoice sits with an approver whose band covers it.
verify: Read the assigned approver band on the pending approval.
Pass when the assigned band covers the invoice amount.

steps.title: Apply dual approval above the finance threshold
sop: Identify invoices above the finance dual-approval threshold.
Ensure a second distinct approver records a decision.
Reject single-approval releases above the threshold.
Done when two approver records exist on such invoices.
verify: Count distinct approver IDs on above-threshold invoices.
Pass when each above-threshold payment carries two distinct approver records.

steps.title: Confirm segregation from the invoice coder and enterer
sop: Compare the approver ID against the invoice entry and coding user IDs.
Reject approvals where they are the same user.
Escalate repeat occurrences to claims leadership.
Done when segregation is confirmed on every approval.
verify: Query approvals for matching approver and coder IDs.
Pass when no ALAE payment is approved by the user who entered or coded it.

steps.title: Confirm the ALAE reserve covers the payment before release
sop: Read the available ALAE reserve balance on the claim.
Compare it against the invoice amount.
Request a reserve increase before approving where the balance is short.
Done when the reserve covers the payment.
verify: Re-read the ALAE reserve balance after any increase.
Pass when the ALAE reserve balance is at least the approved payment amount.

steps.title: Record the approval decision in the claims platform
sop: Record approve or reject in the invoice approval workflow.
State the basis for any partial approval.
Do not record approvals by email.
Done when the decision is saved with approver ID and timestamp.
verify: Open the invoice approval history.
Pass when the decision, approver ID and timestamp are all recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims moving to closed status that carry an open ALAE tracking record
generic.In-scope period: Claims closed during the current accounting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure date, closing handler, final ALAE total and reserve release amount populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final ALAE total equals the sum of posted expense payments on the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure entry on the ALAE tracking record retained with date and handler
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed or outstanding invoices are logged and the closure is deferred
generic.Test population: Claims closed in the period with ALAE tracking in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero closed claims carrying a residual open ALAE reserve balance
generic.Exception handling path: Further expense on a closed claim requires a formal reopen rather than a direct payment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No unpaid vendor invoice remains against a claim with ALAE tracking closed
generic.Evidence location: ALAE tracking record on the claim and the expense reserve account in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Confirm no vendor invoice is outstanding or in dispute
sop: List all vendor invoices raised against the claim.
Confirm each is paid, short-paid with agreement, or formally rejected.
Defer closure where any invoice is outstanding or disputed.
Done when no invoice remains open or disputed.
verify: Query open invoices for the claim in the platform.
Pass when the open invoice count for the claim is zero.

steps.title: Reconcile final ALAE total to posted expense payments
sop: Sum posted expense payments on the claim.
Compare against the final ALAE total shown on the tracking record.
Investigate and correct any difference before closing.
Done when the two figures agree.
verify: Re-run the comparison after correction.
Pass when final ALAE total equals the sum of posted expense payments.

steps.title: Release the residual ALAE reserve to zero
sop: Read the remaining ALAE reserve balance on the claim.
Post a release transaction taking the balance to zero.
Do not leave a stranded balance on the closed claim.
Done when the ALAE reserve balance is zero.
verify: Read the ALAE reserve balance after the release.
Pass when the closed claim shows a zero ALAE reserve balance.

steps.title: Confirm the release feeds the ERP expense reserve account
sop: Trace the release transaction to the ERP ledger entry.
Confirm the expense reserve account is reduced by the released amount.
Raise a defect where the feed does not appear.
Done when the ledger reflects the release.
verify: Compare the ledger movement to the released amount.
Pass when the ledger expense reserve reduction equals the released balance.

steps.title: Record the closure date and closing handler on the tracking record
sop: Enter the closure date on the ALAE tracking record.
Record the closing handler ID.
Add a closing note summarising final ALAE by category.
Done when the closure entry is complete.
verify: Open the tracking record and read the closure fields.
Pass when closure date and closing handler are both populated.

steps.title: Confirm further expense requires a formal reopen
sop: Confirm the claim status blocks new expense payments.
Test that a payment attempt is rejected without a reopen.
Raise a control defect where payment is still possible.
Done when the block is confirmed effective.
verify: Attempt a controlled expense entry on the closed claim.
Pass when the platform rejects the entry without a formal reopen.

generic.Defined scope/population: Defense counsel, expert, court cost, IA and surveillance invoices awaiting coding
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received in the current coding cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: ALAE category, claim number, accident year, line of business and invoice document ID
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of coded claim allocations equals the invoice gross amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Invoice PDF stored in OpenText with document ID referenced on the transaction
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invoices coded to a generic bucket are logged and recoded with the reason
generic.Test population: All ALAE expense transactions posted in the period in Guidewire ClaimCenter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero expense transactions coded to a generic or unallocated ALAE bucket
generic.Exception handling path: Multi-claim invoices are split by claim number before posting rather than posted whole
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Staff-counsel and general handling time is never coded as ALAE
generic.Evidence location: Expense transaction in ClaimCenter and the invoice PDF in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Retrieve the invoice PDF from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Locate the invoice in OpenText and confirm it is legible and complete.
Record the document ID for referencing on the transaction.
Request a replacement where pages are missing.
Done when a complete invoice and its document ID are available.
verify: Open the document by its ID.
Pass when the document opens and shows the full invoice.

steps.title: Code each invoice line to its ALAE category in ClaimCenter
sop: Assign defense counsel fees, expert fees, court costs, IA fees or surveillance per line.
Do not post to a generic or unallocated ALAE bucket.
Query the vendor where the line description is ambiguous.
Done when every line carries a specific ALAE category.
verify: Filter posted lines for generic or unallocated categories.
Pass when no expense transaction sits in a generic ALAE bucket.

steps.title: Split multi-claim invoices by claim number
sop: Identify invoices covering more than one claim.
Allocate each line to its claim number.
Confirm allocations sum to the invoice gross amount.
Done when the invoice is fully allocated across claims.
verify: Sum the allocations posted for the invoice.
Pass when the allocation sum equals the invoice gross amount.

steps.title: Confirm staff-counsel and handling time is not coded as ALAE
sop: Identify lines representing staff counsel or internal handling time.
Exclude them from ALAE coding.
Route them to the appropriate internal expense treatment.
Done when no internal time remains coded as ALAE.
verify: Review posted ALAE lines for internal time descriptions.
Pass when no staff-counsel or general handling time appears in ALAE.

steps.title: Match accident year and line of business to the claim
sop: Compare the coded accident year and line against the claim record.
Correct mismatches before posting so expense triangles stay clean.
Log the correction where a mismatch is found.
Done when both dimensions match the claim.
verify: Re-compare coded dimensions against the claim record.
Pass when accident year and line of business match the claim on every line.

steps.title: Attach the invoice and reference its document ID on the transaction
sop: Attach the invoice PDF to the claim in ClaimCenter.
Enter the OpenText document ID on the expense transaction.
Do not post an expense transaction without the source invoice.
Done when every transaction references its invoice.
verify: Open each posted transaction and follow the document reference.
Pass when every posted ALAE transaction has its source invoice attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open and recently closed claims with ALAE spend measured against incurred indemnity
generic.In-scope period: ALAE and indemnity positions as at the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: ALAE total, incurred indemnity, claim type, litigation plan budget and vendor breakdown
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Vendor breakdown per claim sums to the claim ALAE total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated flag list retained with the ratio threshold version applied
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Justified high-ALAE claims are logged with the strategy reason recorded
generic.Test population: Claims in the enterprise data warehouse with ALAE and incurred indemnity for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every claim above the ALAE ratio threshold to appear on the review list
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged claims without an action receive a documented expense-control action or justification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ratio ranked against the peer band for the claim type rather than a single global figure
generic.Evidence location: Management review list in the data warehouse and the flag on the claim record

steps.title: Compute ALAE as a percentage of incurred indemnity per claim
sop: Extract ALAE and incurred indemnity per claim from the warehouse.
Compute the ratio for each claim.
Exclude claims with zero indemnity from ratio ranking and treat separately.
Done when ratios are computed across the population.
verify: Recompute a sample of ratios from the raw figures.
Pass when sampled ratios match the computed values.

steps.title: Rank each claim against the peer band for its claim type
sop: Group claims by claim type and compute the peer band.
Rank each claim within its own band.
Do not compare across unlike claim types.
Done when each claim carries a peer-band rank.
verify: Check ranks are computed within claim type groups.
Pass when every claim is ranked against its own claim type peer band.

steps.title: Flag claims above the ratio threshold or over litigation budget
sop: Flag claims exceeding the defined ALAE ratio threshold.
Flag claims whose ALAE exceeds the litigation plan budget.
Set the flag on the claim record in the claims platform.
Done when all qualifying claims are flagged.
verify: Compare flagged claims to the qualifying list.
Pass when every qualifying claim appears on the management review list.

steps.title: Exclude justified high-ALAE claims with a recorded reason
sop: Review flagged claims for a defense verdict strategy or coverage action.
Exclude such claims with the justification recorded on the claim.
Do not exclude without a written reason.
Done when justified exclusions are recorded.
verify: Read the exclusion reasons on excluded claims.
Pass when every exclusion carries a recorded justification.

steps.title: Route flagged claims with vendor breakdown to the claims manager
sop: Attach the vendor spend breakdown to each flagged claim entry.
Confirm vendor amounts sum to the claim ALAE total.
Deliver the list to the claims manager on the reporting date.
Done when the list is routed with vendor detail.
verify: Sum vendor amounts per flagged claim.
Pass when vendor breakdown totals equal claim ALAE totals.

steps.title: Confirm each flagged claim receives an action or accepted justification
sop: Review each flagged claim at the expense control review.
Record an expense-control action or accept the justification.
Do not leave flagged claims without a decision.
Done when every flagged claim has a recorded outcome.
verify: List flagged claims and read their recorded outcomes.
Pass when no flagged claim remains without an action or accepted justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved ALAE invoices queued for release in the current disbursement run
generic.In-scope period: Payments with an effective date inside the open accounting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, invoice number, payee, bank details, ALAE cost type and effective date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursement batch total equals the sum of approved invoice amounts
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Payment record with release timestamp retained in the payment system and the ERP ledger
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Payments held for bank detail mismatch are logged with the verification outcome
generic.Test population: ALAE payments released in the period from the payment and subrogation system
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero payments released to a payee whose bank details differ from the vendor master
generic.Exception handling path: In-flight bank changes are rejected and re-verified through the vendor master process
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Payment reduces the ALAE reserve and posts to the ALAE expense account
generic.Evidence location: Payment record in the payment system and the ALAE expense account in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Confirm a current approval exists before release
sop: Check the invoice carries a current approval record.
Reject items where the approval has been superseded or withdrawn.
Do not release on a verbal or emailed approval.
Done when a valid approval is confirmed.
verify: Read the approval record linked to the payment.
Pass when a current approval is present and covers the amount.

steps.title: Match payee and bank details to the vendor master
sop: Compare payee name and remittance bank details against the vendor master.
Reject any bank detail changed in flight with the payment.
Route bank changes through the vendor master verification process.
Done when payee and bank details match the master record.
verify: Re-compare the payment record to the vendor master entry.
Pass when payee and bank details match the vendor master exactly.

steps.title: Confirm the ALAE cost type and reserve reduction
sop: Confirm the payment carries the ALAE cost type.
Confirm it reduces the ALAE reserve rather than indemnity.
Correct the coding before release where it is wrong.
Done when cost type and reserve impact are correct.
verify: Read the cost type and reserve impact on the pending payment.
Pass when the payment carries the ALAE cost type and reduces the ALAE reserve.

steps.title: Carry the invoice number on the payment for duplicate control
sop: Enter the vendor invoice number on the payment record.
Confirm the duplicate-invoice control can read the field.
Reject payments with a blank invoice number.
Done when every payment carries its invoice number.
verify: Query the batch for blank invoice numbers.
Pass when no payment in the batch has a blank invoice number.

steps.title: Confirm the effective date sits in the open accounting period
sop: Compare the payment effective date against the open period calendar.
Adjust the date to a valid open period date where needed.
Never post into a closed period.
Done when all effective dates are in the open period.
verify: Re-check effective dates against the period calendar.
Pass when every payment effective date falls in the open period.

steps.title: Release the batch and confirm posting to the ERP ledger
sop: Release the payment batch from the payment system.
Confirm each payment posts to the ALAE expense account in the ERP.
Investigate any payment that fails to post the same day.
Done when all released payments are posted.
verify: Compare the released batch total to the ERP ALAE posting total.
Pass when posted ALAE payments carry claim number, invoice number and ALAE cost type.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims closing in the period that carry a booked ALAE accrual
generic.In-scope period: The accounting period in which the claim closes
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cumulative accrual, total ALAE paid, variance amount and variance cause populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accrual released plus paid ALAE equals the cumulative accrued amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed reconciliation retained with the closing date and ledger period reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances above the materiality threshold are logged with the cause and treatment
generic.Test population: Claims closed in the period with an ALAE accrual in the ERP ledger
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero ALAE accrual balances remaining on closed and reconciled claims
generic.Exception handling path: Over-accruals are released and under-accruals trued up in the same period
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Systematic variance patterns are fed back into the ALAE accrual basis
generic.Evidence location: Reconciliation file and the ALAE accrual account in the ERP general ledger

steps.title: Extract paid ALAE and cumulative accrual for closing claims
sop: Extract total ALAE paid per closing claim from the claims platform.
Extract the cumulative ALAE accrued from the ERP ledger.
Align both extracts to the closing date.
Done when both figures are available per claim.
verify: Compare extract totals to the ledger ALAE accrual account balance.
Pass when extract accrual totals tie to the ledger balance.

steps.title: Compare paid against accrued for each closing claim
sop: Compute the variance between paid and accrued per claim.
Rank variances by absolute size.
Flag those above the materiality threshold.
Done when variances are computed and flagged.
verify: Recompute a sample of variances from the raw figures.
Pass when sampled variances match the reconciliation file.

steps.title: Explain material variances by cause
sop: Classify each material variance as budget overrun, unbudgeted expert or over-accrual.
Record the cause against the claim on the reconciliation.
Refer unexplained variances back to the handling examiner.
Done when every material variance carries a cause.
verify: Read the cause field on flagged variances.
Pass when no material variance is left without a recorded cause.

steps.title: Release over-accruals and true up under-accruals in the period
sop: Post releases for over-accrued balances.
Post true-ups for under-accrued balances.
Do not carry either forward into the next period.
Done when all adjustments are posted in the current period.
verify: Re-read the accrual balance after the adjustments.
Pass when no accrual balance remains against a closed reconciled claim.

steps.title: Sign off the reconciliation for the closing population
sop: Compile the reconciliation with variances and treatments.
Obtain and record the sign-off with date.
Do not certify the close without the sign-off.
Done when the signed reconciliation is filed.
verify: Open the filed reconciliation and read the sign-off block.
Pass when a dated sign-off is present for the closing population.

steps.title: Feed systematic variance patterns into the accrual basis
sop: Group variance causes across the period to spot systematic patterns.
Recommend an accrual basis change where a pattern repeats.
Raise the recommendation as a tracked action.
Done when patterns are documented and actions raised.
verify: Read the pattern summary and the raised actions.
Pass when each recurring pattern has a tracked accrual basis action.

generic.Defined scope/population: ALAE amounts by claim, line of business, accident year and cost category for the closing period
generic.In-scope period: The financial close period being reported
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim, line, accident year, cost category, ALAE amount and prior-period comparative
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report total ties to the general ledger loss adjustment expense balance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report retained with version number and issue timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments beyond the variance tolerance are logged with commentary and owner
generic.Test population: ALAE data extracted from the ERP ledger and the enterprise data warehouse for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the report issued by the close-calendar deadline and tied to the GL
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciling differences are cleared before issue rather than footnoted after certification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: ALAE is reported separately from ULAE so statutory schedules are not misstated
generic.Evidence location: Issued ALAE close report and the loss adjustment expense account in the ERP ledger

steps.title: Produce the ALAE report by claim, line, year and category
sop: Extract ALAE for the closing period from the ERP and the warehouse.
Present by claim, line of business, accident year and cost category.
Confirm no segment is missing from the breakdown.
Done when the report is produced at the required granularity.
verify: Sum the segments and compare to the extract total.
Pass when segment totals equal the period ALAE extract total.

steps.title: Reconcile the report total to the general ledger LAE balance
sop: Compare the report total against the GL loss adjustment expense balance.
Investigate and clear differences before issuing.
Record any permanent reconciling item with its explanation.
Done when the report ties to the GL.
verify: Re-run the tie-out after clearing differences.
Pass when the report total equals the GL LAE balance.

steps.title: Separate ALAE from ULAE in the reported figures
sop: Identify any unallocated loss adjustment expense in the extract.
Exclude ULAE from the reported ALAE figures.
Report ULAE separately where required.
Done when the two are separated.
verify: Test the reported ALAE for ULAE cost codes.
Pass when no ULAE amounts are included in reported ALAE figures.

steps.title: Add variance commentary against prior period and plan
sop: Compare each material segment against prior period and plan.
Write commentary naming the drivers of each movement.
Refer unexplained movements to the handling unit before issue.
Done when every material segment has commentary.
verify: List material segments and read their commentary.
Pass when no material segment is issued without variance commentary.

steps.title: Issue the report by the close-calendar workday deadline
sop: Read the close-calendar deadline for the ALAE report.
Issue to the distribution list before that workday.
Do not issue after the books are certified.
Done when the report is issued and the issue date recorded.
verify: Compare the issue timestamp to the close-calendar deadline.
Pass when the report was issued on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Retain the issued version with its reconciliation evidence
sop: Store the issued report version with the tie-out working.
Record the version number and issue timestamp.
Supersede prior drafts so only the issued version is authoritative.
Done when the issued version and evidence are retained.
verify: Open the retained package and read the version marker.
Pass when the retained report version matches the issued distribution.

generic.Defined scope/population: Vendor invoices received on claims and awaiting accuracy and compliance review
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received in the current review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Billed rates, hours, timekeeper, invoice number, claim number and review outcome
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved amount plus recorded reductions equals the invoice gross amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review outcome and adjustment reason retained against the invoice with date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Off-schedule rates approved by exception are logged with the authorising decision
generic.Test population: All vendor invoices reviewed in the period in the claims management platform
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a documented review outcome on every vendor invoice
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicate invoices are rejected outright and the vendor notified
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billed rates match the panel counsel or vendor fee schedule
generic.Evidence location: Invoice review record on the claim and the invoice in the claim file repository

steps.title: Check billed rates against the panel or vendor fee schedule
sop: Read the contracted rate for each timekeeper from the fee schedule.
Compare against the billed rate on each line.
Reject off-schedule rates unless a recorded exception exists.
Done when every rate is checked against the schedule.
verify: Re-compare approved rates against the fee schedule.
Pass when no invoice is approved above the contracted rate without a recorded exception.

steps.title: Test for block billing and duplicate time entries
sop: Scan for block-billed entries covering multiple tasks in one line.
Scan for identical time entries repeated on the same date.
Mark such lines for reduction.
Done when block billing and duplicates are identified.
verify: Re-scan the invoice after reductions are applied.
Pass when no block-billed or duplicated line remains approved.

steps.title: Test for clerical time billed at professional rates
sop: Identify administrative or clerical tasks in the narrative.
Reduce lines charging professional rates for such tasks.
Record the reduction reason on each line.
Done when clerical time is reduced or removed.
verify: Review reduced lines and their reasons.
Pass when clerical tasks are no longer billed at professional rates.

steps.title: Confirm billed work was authorised in the litigation plan
sop: Compare billed activities against the litigation plan or expert engagement.
Query unauthorised work with the vendor before paying.
Reduce lines for work outside the authorised scope.
Done when all billed work is confirmed authorised.
verify: Map approved lines to plan activities.
Pass when every approved line maps to authorised planned work.

steps.title: Test the invoice number against previously paid invoices
sop: Search paid history for the same vendor invoice number on the claim.
Search across other claims for the same invoice number.
Reject confirmed duplicates and notify the vendor.
Done when duplicate testing is complete.
verify: Re-run the duplicate search before approval.
Pass when no approved invoice number has been paid previously.

steps.title: Record the review outcome and any reduction reason
sop: Record approve, reduce or reject as the review outcome.
State the reduced amount and the adjustment reason for short-paid invoices.
Confirm approved plus reduced equals the gross amount.
Done when the outcome and reasons are recorded.
verify: Add approved and reduced amounts on the invoice record.
Pass when each invoice shows a documented outcome and the amounts reconcile to gross.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims incurring legal, expert, independent adjuster, surveillance or court costs
generic.In-scope period: Expense commitments and payments in the current file review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expense category, exposure, committed amount, paid amount and vendor on each entry
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked ALAE incurred equals posted expense payments plus outstanding commitments
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Commitment entry retained with engagement date and vendor reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Commitments recorded late are logged with the engagement date and the reason
generic.Test population: Open claims with expense activity in the claims management platform for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires ALAE incurred shown by category with paid and outstanding components
generic.Exception handling path: Unallocated expenses on multi-claimant losses are reallocated to the correct exposure
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Commitments are recorded at engagement rather than only when the invoice arrives
generic.Evidence location: ALAE tracking view on the claim summary in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Record each expense commitment at the point of engagement
sop: Create a commitment entry when counsel, an expert or an IA is engaged.
Record the engagement date, vendor and estimated amount.
Do not wait for the first invoice to record the commitment.
Done when every engagement has a commitment entry.
verify: Compare engagement records to commitment entries.
